title: CryptoCounsel Pro
tagline: Empowering Your Financial Future on Web3: Seamless, Secure, and Smart.
description: I'm creating a revolutionary financial advisory platform on Web3, leveraging Safe Protocol for seamless, gasless transactions. My platform facilitates real-time communication between users and expert advisors through a secure and encrypted Push Chat, stored on IPFS for added security. Advisors can notify their followers about updates, while users can send chat invitations via Push Notifications. Additionally, I offer a Push Video feature for users who prefer video calls with their advisors. The platform also offers a comprehensive view of users' connected wallet addresses, showcasing their token holdings and NFTs. With detailed token price charts, I'm empowering users to make informed investment decisions, making this platform the go-to hub for personalized financial advice and portfolio management.
how_its_made: I am creating my Web3 financial advisory platform, starting by selecting a blockchain network like mumbai and integrating Safe Protocol for gasless transactions. I'll use IPFS for secure chat storage and develop a user-friendly frontend with real-time chat and push notifications. I'll also integrate blockchain wallets for users to manage their assets, display token holdings and NFTs, and create token price charts. My priority is on security and compliance with financial regulations, and I'm focusing on providing an excellent user experience. I'm planning for scalability and ongoing maintenance. I will implement a monetization strategy and work on building a community around my platform for success in the Web3 space.
